interfaces.name: bore
interfaces.what: the inner ring's Ø10.0000 bore, axis z, fitted at centre (0.0000, 0.0000, 1.5000) over 2.6000 mm of its 3.0000 mm width with 355.0 deg of cover and a 0.0000 mm fit residual. It goes onto a Ø10 boss — part:microduck-shin 'ankle' (Ø10.0 x 3.2) and part:microduck-jaw 'bearing_journal' (Ø10.0000 x 2.7000). The frame origin is the ring's z=0 face on the axis, which is the mesh's own datum.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's seeed_bearing__configuration_default.stl by cecad.meshfeatures.cylinders (least-squares cylinder fit per smooth patch; the fit residual and angular cover of every feature quoted here are in the artifact), frozen 2026-09-02 by tools/measure_mesh_features.py into out/laneT/features/seeed_bearing__configuration_default.json (lane T)

interfaces.name: od
interfaces.what: the outer ring's Ø15.0000 diameter, axis z, fitted at centre (0.0000, 0.0000, 1.5000) over 2.4000 mm with 355.0 deg of cover and a 0.0000 mm fit residual; bbox 15.0000 x 15.0000 x 3.0000. It seats in a Ø15 pocket (part:microduck-ankle-left/-right 'ankle_bearing', Ø15.0 x 2.3) OR is laid in the Ø15.000000 open arch of part:microduck-motor-support 'lens_tube' (free-centre circle fit to the mesh vertices at four x stations, 2026-09-03, residual max 0.0000007 mm — line-to-line with this Ø15.000000 race, diametral gap 0.0000 mm; the Ø14.9938-14.9978 published on 2026-09-02 was a meshslice chord fit reading one half-sagitta small) — hence two accepted connections, which are different joints and are graded by different folders.
